mapper.select: SELECT groups.powtoon_group_code, groups.name, groups.powtoon_parent_group_code, groups.master_id, groups.created_time, groups.updated_time FROM groups LEFT JOIN user_groups ON groups.powtoon_group_code = user_groups.powtoon_group_code AND user_groups.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN user_managed_groups ON groups.powtoon_group_code = user_managed_groups.powtoon_group_code AND user_managed_groups.user_id = #{userId} WHERE master_id = #{masterId} AND (user_groups.powtoon_group_code IS NOT NULL OR user_managed_groups.powtoon_group_code IS NOT NULL)
